comment: Commands and fields the Windows port adds that upstream does not have. Parity tests check: port = parity/surface.json + parity/adopted.json + this file, and no entry here exists in docs/upstream/surface-v0.36.0.json. Described in docs/PLATFORM-NOTES.md, section Windows-only extensions.

commands.reason: Sets or clears a workspace's own terminal theme.

workspaceNode.name: theme
workspaceNode.reason: Reports the workspace's own terminal theme in tree.

workspaceSnapshot.name: theme
workspaceSnapshot.reason: Persists the workspace's own terminal theme.

settings.name: sidebarThemeColors
settings.reason: Turns off the theme colors on the sidebar rows of workspaces with their own theme.

settings.name: sidebarThemeStyle
settings.reason: Picks how the sidebar rows show their workspace theme: the whole row, a square on the right, or a block around the name.

settings.name: restoreScrollback
settings.reason: Turns off restoring each pane's previous output after a relaunch.

settings.name: overlayOpacity
settings.reason: Sets overlay panel background opacity while Windows transparency effects are enabled.

settings.name: closeOnShellExit
settings.reason: Keeps a shell pane open with its exit code when the shell exits, by default when the code is not 0.
